# Esther

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 ch.Philippa P7](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0007)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher  <sub>[v3 ch.Wedding P19](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0019)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Mrs. Esther Bell is described as being the picture of health.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P43](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0043)_

## Personality

Esther is described as a dear girl who has a tendency to be given to fads. Additionally, she lacks sufficient imagination and is prone to indigestion.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Philippa P7](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0007)_

## Traits

- given to fads  <sub>[v3 ch.Philippa P7](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0007)</sub>
- lacks imagination  <sub>[v3 ch.Philippa P7](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0007)</sub>

## Goals

## History

Esther was born as a new baby boy to [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md) during [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Diana's subscription canvassing efforts in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Her father was so overjoyed by her birth that he gave [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a generous five-dollar donation for the cause.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P37](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0037), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P44](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0044), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P49](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0049), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P56](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0056)_
